name: sprint21_taker_imbalance_continuation_altcoins_v2
hypothesis: Extreme smoothed taker-buy volume imbalance (order-flow, EFMA 2025) predicts short-horizon continuation on liquid altcoins; sprint19 never tested this (symbols field was a string, iterated as characters -> 0 loads).
power_argument: sprint18 realized 5866 validation trades on this identical 8-symbol basket/window with cap=8/day, so data loads cleanly. Prior artifacts back-solve per-trade stdev ~60bps (sprint18: 28.25*sqrt(5866)/35.805=60.4bps). At n=300, t=2, two-sided: min detectable edge = 2*60/sqrt(300) ~= 6.9bps net, well inside range. threshold=2.0 (~top 2-3% of smoothed z) with cap=5/day/symbol x 8 symbols x ~92 validation days (up to 3680 slots) should clear 300 easily.
